lines.speaker: safehouse_keeper
lines.text: Green pennant. You know what it means or you wouldn't have come up the alley. Cellar's dry, there's a pot on, and nobody asks names.

lines.speaker: safehouse_keeper
lines.text: Four generations. Great-great-grandmother wouldn't sell the corner in 2031 and every one of us since has been stuck with what that turned into.

lines.speaker: safehouse_keeper
lines.text: You look at that sign like you've seen it before. It's older than the water.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is the same board. Scorched along one edge, green pennant on the left, and you were standing under it a hundred and seventeen years ago this morning.
